scenarios.headline: 🚨 URGENT: Your student loan forgiveness grant has been approved! Claim within 15 minutes before the federal window closes forever.
scenarios.context: A student receives an unexpected text message containing a shortened Bitly link.
scenarios.explanation: Scammers impose tight artificial deadlines (15 minutes) to induce panic and prevent the recipient from checking official government portals independently.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Stop! Never click unsolicited SMS links. Open StudentAid.gov directly in a new tab.

scenarios.headline: “Either you stand with our complete digital surveillance bill, or you want terrorists to walk into our airports freely!”
scenarios.platform: Cable News Interview / X Viral Clip
scenarios.context: A politician defends a controversial metadata logging bill during a heated broadcast interview.
scenarios.explanation: The speaker erases dozens of nuanced privacy-preserving security alternatives and frames the issue as a manipulative either/or ultimatum.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Find Better Coverage: Read independent legal analyses from non-profit civil liberty institutes.

scenarios.headline: “Leading scientists all secretly agree that 5G frequencies alter human brainwaves. Mainstream media refuses to report this cover-up!”
scenarios.context: A video with dramatic ominous background music racking up 2.4 million views.
scenarios.explanation: Uses the absence of mainstream coverage as supposed 'proof' of a cover-up, while relying on vague weasel words ('leading scientists') without naming a single institution.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Trace Claim: Check WHO and IEEE telecommunications radiation consensus reports.

scenarios.headline: “Don't bother reading Dr. Sarah Lin's economic study on inflation—she drives a luxury sports car and is clearly an out-of-touch elitist!”
scenarios.context: A commenter dismisses a 60-page peer-reviewed economic paper by attacking the author's vehicle.
scenarios.explanation: Attacks the researcher's personal lifestyle rather than examining the statistical methodology or data presented in the paper.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Investigate Source: Read peer economists' reviews of her methodology, not personal insults.

scenarios.headline: “Our city had 10 inches of snow last night! Global climate change is officially a total hoax invented by bureaucrats!”
scenarios.context: A photo of a snowed-in driveway posted during a severe winter storm.
scenarios.explanation: Confuses short-term localized weather with multi-decade global climate trends, cherry-picking one freezing day while ignoring 50 years of planetary heat data.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Find Better Coverage: Consult NASA and NOAA aggregate climate anomaly maps.

scenarios.headline: “World-famous football superstar Cristiano endorses this herbal detox tea. He has 600M followers, so it must cure metabolic diseases!”
scenarios.context: An athlete with immense global sports fame promotes an unregulated dietary supplement.
scenarios.explanation: Assumes athletic talent and celebrity charisma equate to biochemical and pharmacological expertise.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Investigate the Source: Verify if the supplement has FDA/EMA clinical safety approval.

scenarios.headline: “If we do not ban this book immediately, civilization will collapse into total anarchy, blood will be on our hands, and society will be ruined forever!”
scenarios.context: An impassioned speaker argues against a library curriculum item.
scenarios.explanation: Uses catastrophic, hyper-apocalyptic doom language to incite acute panic rather than discussing the book's specific age appropriateness.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Stop: Recognize emotional alarmism and ask for balanced pedagogical reviews.

scenarios.headline: “Over 10 million young investors have already deposited money into Quantum-Yield Token this month. Don't be left behind!”
scenarios.context: A sponsored banner urging viewers to join an unregulated crypto liquidity pool.
scenarios.explanation: Uses sheer numbers and FOMO (fear of missing out) to convince victims that a scheme must be legitimate because millions allegedly joined.
scenarios.sift_recommendation: Investigate Source: Search SEC and FTC registries for registered investment licenses.
